record_title: Emmy Noether: modern LaTeX drafts, translations, and source-audit packages
summary: Targeted German cumulative source-critical candidate promoting existing GDZ raw-source audit findings for Papers 09, 10, and 11 into a fresh RA47-based cumulative German TeX candidate.
contents: German cumulative RA56 candidate TeX/PDF/log compiled twice with pdflatex
source PDF cutouts for Paper 09 Math. Ann. 77 pp.103-128, Paper 10 Math. Ann. 77 pp.536-545, and Paper 11 Math. Ann. 78 pp.221-229
targeted 1000dpi labelled witness crops for accepted fixes
RA56 applied-fix CSV, prior GDZ source-audit fix/no-fix CSVs, P11 Omega-Gamma occurrence ledger, build summary, and checksums

papers: Paper 09, Die allgemeinsten Bereiche aus ganzen transzendenten Zahlen
main_repairs: P09: restores source-visible author line and corrects the first Zermelo footnote citation to Math. Ann. 75, S. 484 (1914)
P10: restores source-visible author line, changes definition (d) terminal index from k_nu to k_sigma, and corrects the divisibility display to use F(t; vartheta_i)
P11: restores source-visible author line, changes all 25 P11 occurrences of \mathfrak L_\Gamma to source \Omega_\Gamma, and corrects final theorem punctuation from colon to semicolon
no_fix_traps: P09 keeps source-visible xi_t and multiplicative module subscripts such as nu kappa
P10 keeps final rank-three formula with real x and the plus/minus sign pairing
P11 keeps plain G_k(x), source spelling Tschirnhausentransformation, and does not silently fold the later erratum into the original P11 body

limitations: German source-critical candidate only; no English/Spanish/Japanese/French/Chinese/Ukrainian/Russian/Interslavic propagation included
targeted Papers 09-11 repairs only; not full page-by-page certification of Papers 09, 10, or 11
not a whole-corpus certification and not a critical edition
